name: mdjs-ultra
description: MD.js Ultra: standalone Markdown, Mermaid, Charts and optional ZX, Blockly/Arduino, PC (XT and 286) labs

scripts.test:zx: npm run test:zx:unit && npm run test:zx:browser
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:zx:unit && npm run test:zx:patch && npm run test:zx:browser
scripts.test:release: npm test && npm run test:blocks && npm run test:zx:unit && npm run test:pc:phase1 && npm run test:pc:browser && npm run test:pc:phase2:browser && npm run test:runtime:browser && npm run test:ultra:browser && npm run test:ux:browser && npm run test:ux:shell && npm run test:pc:phase3:compat && npm run test:pc:phase4a && npm run test:pc:phase4b && npm run test:pc:phase4d && npm run test:pc:phase4e:hardening
scripts.test:pc:phase2:browser: python3 optional/pc/tests/test_video_browser.py && python3 optional/pc/tests/test_floppy_browser.py && python3 optional/pc/tests/test_freedos_browser.py
scripts.test:pc: npm run test:pc:phase1 && npm run test:pc:browser
scripts.test:ux:browser: python3 optional/blockly/tests/browser.py && python3 optional/blockly/tests/test_dnd_browser.py && python3 optional/blockly/tests/test_education_playback_browser.py && python3 zx/tests/e2e/test_keyboard_ux_browser.py && python3 optional/pc/tests/test_video_browser.py
scripts.test:stabilize: npm test && npm run test:blocks && npm run test:zx:unit && npm run test:pc:phase1 && npm run test:ux:shell && npm run test:runtime:browser
scripts.test:stabilization2: npm run test:blocks && npm run test:pc:phase1 && python3 optional/blockly/tests/test_education_playback_browser.py && python3 optional/blockly/tests/browser.py && python3 optional/pc/tests/test_freedos_browser.py
scripts.test:pc:phase3:speaker: node --test optional/pc/phase3/speaker-3a.test.cjs && python3 optional/pc/phase3/test_speaker_browser.py
scripts.test:pc:phase3:compat: npm run test:pc:phase3:preflight && npm run test:pc:phase3:browser && npm run test:pc:phase3:tune
